qw241w4r833t.title: Investigating Potential Issue - Delayed Notifications(SMS/Voice/Email) and impact to Email Integration

sjs7sdkrqmlb.body:
Between approximately 10:30 and 11:18 UTC , you might have experienced delayed delivery of incident notifications (push, SMS, call, and email). No notifications were lost. All notifications were eventually delivered, but with delay.

Our team identified the issue within minutes and took action to restore normal processing. Notification delivery returned to normal by 11:18 UTC

We apologize for the delay this may have caused to your incident response workflow.
